metadata.summary: Bounded Kanban documentary state and conservative lifecycle-event polling; no execution control.

semantics.description: See ../DESIGN.md. Sole backend authority, public board mapping and trusted exact caller enforcement. Documentary triage create/title-body edit/comments only. Last-writer-wins, best-effort requestKey not native idempotency. Unknown writes never retried automatically; broker timeout/cancel also UNKNOWN mutation outcome. Events always continuity UNKNOWN, bounded pull, replay duplicates expected. No dispatch/control/dependencies or production adoption.

evidence.conformance: conformance.json and docs/phase5k/evidence/conformance-attempt7.log: actual19/19, real supported Hermes REST/WS, real restart/no-worker audit; synthetic-test credential only, no production qualification.

proposal.abstraction: One method-specific orchestration/kanban capability with board/get/list/create/update/comment/events; no generic work service.
proposal.alternatives: No direct SQL/private router/dashboard scraping, no new state service or execution control.
proposal.compatibility: Purely additive; original Catalog/Kernel/ACAP/Foundation unchanged. Weak concurrency and UNKNOWN outcomes explicit.
consumers: Separate public SDK consumer without Hermes or adapter internals
proposal.existingInsufficient: Echo, records, memory and assurance lack Kanban task and event semantics.
proposal.genericRationale: Kanban task documentary states and bounded event replay without provider filesystem, PID, profile or schema.
proposal.problem: Public consumers need durable board/task documentary state through sole Hermes authority, not a duplicate database.
providers: Independent Kanban backend future candidate only, not required
proposal.scopes: Application/session labels plus exact public board mapping, no implicit ancestry or cross-board lookup.
proposal.security: Host operation grants and exact trusted caller mapping; isolated backend/no credentials inheritance; payload cannot supply authority; service credential is broad so adapter is trusted enforcement.

evidence.reference: Explicit Phase5.K isolated DEV execution/publication authorization; local namespace maintainer workflow, not Owner Acceptance/signature or operational authority.

review.rationale: DESIGN ONLY. Same-reviewer finite closure of the two previously blocking findings: K9-RESULT-SHAPE and K12-BOUNDED-READ-SEMANTICS. Both are resolved in the inspected DEV amendment. No review expansion, executed-conformance claim, production permission or Catalog admission is implied.
